EmissionEvent, Typ VOC 1000
Our EmissionEvent VOC test chambers are used for conducting tests and analyses of VOC emissions from vehicles and interiors. Optional features include various test chamber sizes, low-emission materials, defined temperature and humidity conditions, and connection options to all common analysis devices. A new development from our company is the nebulization cooling system for the analysis of condensable VOC components.
Reliable measurements are ensured by:
CO2 refrigeration technology as standard from 2025
1 m3 compact test chamber
Low-emission test chamber (purity in the molecular range)
Eliminates contamination from the surrounding area
Very minimal absorption and absorption effects
Connections to all standard analysis devices are possible
Defined and reproducible temperature and humidity conditions in an emission-free test space
Fogging cooling system for analysing condensable VOC components
